run_stopesModule_from_cli: run a StopesModule from CLI using Hydra config with python -m stopes.modules
build_stopesModule_from_config: build a StopesModule instance from a Hydra DictConfig using StopesModule.build
launch_module_in_debug_mode: launch a StopesModule in debug mode by setting launcher.cluster=debug in config
dry_run_stopesModule: preview a StopesModule configuration without running it by setting dry_run=true
schedule_module_async: schedule a StopesModule for async execution using launcher.schedule with an event loop
